ratio_convention: after/before; less than one is fewer cycles
statistic_notes: All cycle ratios are candidate/original baseline, lower is better.
Group cycle sums add one per-input median per case. Throughput uses total pixels divided by summed per-input median elapsed nanoseconds; it is not a geometric mean of throughput.
The geometric mean weights each input equally. Neither aggregation predicts application input frequency.
Full synthetic native comparisons retain all 120 cases. Image comparisons retain only the 98 exact output-policy matches, with 22 explicit differences unchanged.
Current selection is recorded separately in EXPERIMENTS.md; completed measurements are preserved even if rejected.
